title: ProjectionSnapshot
description: Versioned replacement input shared by Evo, standalone/managed hosts and clients.

chain.description: Exactly one logical chain; every history reference is relative to it.

inputs.description: Exactly one input for each destination, including unavailable destinations.

version.description: Required shared input version, independent of controller payload versions.

workspace_id.description: Authorized workspace scope; a chain alone does not establish visibility.

ApiVersion.description: Required protocol discriminator, independent of the Cargo package version.

ChainRef.description: Opaque engine-issued logical chain reference; not a storage URL or workspace ID.

FreshnessStatus.description: Provider's explicit assessment; clocks and operation-ID order cannot imply it.

oneOf.description: Provider has established that its declared coverage is current.
Provider knows that its derivation requires rebuilding.

ProjectionAvailability.description: Scope completeness, independent of freshness or the number of returned rows.

oneOf.description: Provider returned all results in the requested scope without known gaps.
Bounded results, unresolved records/content, or incomplete derivation.
The adapter or required controller mapping is unavailable.

ProjectionCount.description: Provider-supplied count of rows in a projection, independent of paging.

ProjectionFreshness.description: Freshness of one result and all of its rows, preserved across client filtering.

checkpoint.description: Opaque provider checkpoint; clients never order it or use it as a page cursor.

generated_at.description: When this result was computed, if supplied; not an ordering watermark.

ProjectionGap.description: A presentable limitation with any exact address known to the provider.

message.description: Provider-supplied explanation; never interpreted as a status code.

reference.description: Missing, conflicted or otherwise unresolved history address, when known.

ProjectionInput.description: One destination's input; completeness and freshness are always explicit.

availability.description: Distinguishes known empty results from partial or unavailable results.

freshness.description: Currentness applies to the entire supplied result.

gaps.description: Explicit limitations, including bounds, conflicts and missing content.

rows.description: Rows in provider order; clients do not sort by observation identity.

total.description: Supplied scope total, possibly unknown for partial/unavailable results.

ProjectionKind.description: Presentation destination, not a controller taxonomy or an engine record kind.

oneOf.description: Items the provider has placed in triage.
Requests the provider has marked as needing human input.

ProjectionReference.description:
Full history address within the enclosing snapshot's logical chain.

At least one of observation/item is required. If both are present, the item
is the logical identity of that observation, not a note target or link endpoint.
Use separate references for targets, endpoints and summary coverage.

item.description: Full 256-bit logical item identity, independent of the observation ID.

observation.description: Full 256-bit observation identity in lowercase hexadecimal, never a prefix.

record_hash.description: Full digest of an exact stored representation, only with an observation.

ProjectionRow.description: One supplied presentation row. Status and labels have no app-core semantics.

key.description: Stable provider key, unique within its destination; never a shortened ID.

labels.description: Opaque supplied labels; app-core never infers them from recorded text.

related.description: Targets, Link endpoints, summary coverage or other supplied history links.

sources.description:
Records that produced the row; each source must name an observation.
Retain its logical item and original encoding digest whenever available.

status.description: Opaque provider status; app-core only filters for exact equality.

summary.description: Optional supplied display text; drill-down uses the retained references.

Timestamp.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch; clocks do not define event/input ordering.

WorkspaceId.description: Stable logical workspace identity, preserved when adopting managed coordination.
